title: Web cursor presence
description: A web-only cursor presence demo for LLP 0025: one generated ephemeral collection, a plain DOM page, WebSocket publish/subscribe, and two real browser clients seeing each other's latest cursor positions.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; page boot calls ensureEphemeralCollections, not loadSchema

web.toolchain: node>=24, cargo, local Google Chrome with Chrome DevTools Protocol

contract.note: The `ephemeral` binding proof (ENG-22479; Exact LLP 0284 §5 item 4): presence through generated bindings alone; the DOM surface stays as the framework-free reference.

web: schema load happens once before browser clients connect
page boot uses non-destructive ephemeral collection ensure
two independent browser contexts connect to one Snapback instance
moving client A's pointer renders A in client B
moving client B's pointer renders B in client A
cursor publishes do not advance durable storage version
opening a second context does not clear the first context's room or outbox
closing one browser context removes its connection-owned cursor from the other
contract: both windows boot the Contract surface over generated bindings
client B's cursor reaches client A's ephemeral BINDING (and vice versa), self styled distinctly
forceEphemeralState is LOCAL-ONLY and dispose restores live state
presence stays live after the force cycle

temporaryPolicy.auth: allow-all local room policy for the v0 web-only demo
